name: What are the common signs that my main water line needs replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs that my main water line needs replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a failing main water line include a sudden drop in water pressure throughout your home, discolored water, or unexplained wet spots in your yard. Higher water bills without a change in usage can also indicate a leak. Regularly checking your water meter for movement when no water is being used can help detect a hidden leak early, which is a key preparation step before contacting a plumber.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include low water pressure, discolored water, wet spots in your yard, or unexpectedly high water bills.
